vetSays.line: 🛡️ Kwame, Salvador, Jamie and Emma met them at the door — 4 put down. Kwame, Salvador, Jamie, Emma are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Jamie, Roman, Boris, Emma and Devon met them at the door — 5 put down. Jamie, Roman, Boris, Emma, Devon are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Leo just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
SYSTEM: "That was... a lot. The producers say the ratings were historic. I don’t know what to do with that sentence."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Boris just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Leo taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Daniyar showed Xavier the Ground Elder — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
Leo drew Ground Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Aki just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Aki met them at the door — 1 put down. Aki is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ines just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Priya just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Akif, Ellis and Priya met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Akif, Ellis, Priya are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Akif just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🌿 Ground Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader The Bailiff (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
